characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: A model with this has a **[Feel No Pain X+]** against psychic wounds

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Each time a model with this ends a Charge move, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of this model’s unit and roll one D6: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers X mortal wound

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: A model with this can **fall-back** at the end of any **fight phase**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model gains a **[Feel No Pain 6+]** while on an **objective** or if it already has one add 1 to the roll instead.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: If a model with this ability is below **starting wounds** at the **end** of your turn roll a D6 and on a 6+ restore 1 wound to this model. If it already has an ability that allows you to roll a dice at the end of your turn and heal add 1 to that roll instead.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: In your **command phase** you can select 1 **Vehicle** unit withing 3" of this model. Roll 1D6 and on a X+ restore D3 wounds to that model.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
A model with this has the following abilities:
- If at the **end of your turn** this model is **below starting wounds** roll a D6 and on a 5+ heal 1
- If this model where to fall below 1 wound while it was above 1 wound instead this model is set at 1 wound
- This model can not have it **leadership characteristic** or **roll** modified
- This model preforms **Snap Shooting** on 4+ instead of 6s

sharedRules.name: Overcharge
sharedRules.description: When rolling for a **Hazardous roll** for a weapon with this ability -1 to the roll

sharedRules.name: Pinned
sharedRules.description: If a unit is **pinned** it suffers -2" to their **movement**, **charge rolls** and **advance rolls**

sharedRules.name: Converstion
sharedRules.description: While the target of this weapon is further then half this weapons **range charecteristic** this model **Critical Hits 4+**

sharedRules.name: Pinning
sharedRules.description: A unit that suffers a wound from a weapon with this is now **Pinned**

sharedRules.name: Rad-Phage
sharedRules.description: A unit that suffers a unsaved wound reduces the targets **toughness** by 1 for the rest of the **phase** it was applied.

sharedRules.name: Hexagrammation
sharedRules.description:
When builidng an an army every unit can select one of these keywords and gain an ability based on it. Every model in a unit must have the same one. If a unit has 2 or more of these at the **start*8 of your turn you must pick one that the atleast 1 model in the unit has. That whole unit is effected as if they all had that Hexagram.


- Stormwing: **Bolter Fire**
- Deathwing: **Champions of the Blade**
- Dreadwing: **Experienced hazard avoiders**
- Ironwing: **Iron Masters**
- Firewing: **King Slayers**
- Ravenwing: **Hidden Speed**

sharedRules.name: Swift of Action
sharedRules.description: All **friendly units** gain +1" to movement and when rolling to see who goes first you can roll an additional dice and discard the lowest value.

sharedRules.name: Bestial Savagery
sharedRules.description: **Infantry** units can **advance**,**shoot** and **charge** in the same turn. **Vehicle** units gain +1 **Melee strength** when they charge tile the end of the turn. All other models gain +1**WS** after a charging till the end of the turn.

sharedRules.name: Discipline and Reslove
sharedRules.description: Add 1 to the **hit roll** of any **ranged attacks** made by **bolt** and/or **auto** weapons

sharedRules.name: Achean Force
sharedRules.description: This weapon is a **Psychic Weapon** for all attacks however you cant double the weapons strength. Instead when doing the **psychic roll** it only increases the **strength** by 2 instead of doubling.

sharedRules.name: Night Vision
sharedRules.description: Attacks made by a **model** with this ignores **[Feel No Pain]** that only trigger due to **ranged attacks**

sharedRules.name: Fear(X)
sharedRules.description: Reduce all **enemy units leadership charecteristic** by X withing 9" of this model. For example Fear(1) would cause a **6+ Ld** would become a **7+Ld**

sharedRules.name: Flawless Execution
sharedRules.description: **ASH HAD A REALLY GOOD IDEA**

sharedRules.name: Lies and Obfuscation
sharedRules.description: A model with this rule is always considered 2" further aways than it actually is when measuring range to it from any enemy model for the purposes of **shooting**,**charge** and any **strategems** declared by an **enemy unit** or your **opponent**.

sharedRules.name: Encarmine Fury
sharedRules.description:
Models with this **rule** gain +1 to wound on a turn they preformed a **charge**
**Vehicle** units also gain +1 **strength** up to a max of 10 when they **charge**

sharedRules.name: Outnumbered
sharedRules.description: A model is **classified** as **Outnumbered** when the number of enemy **models** in the **same combat** is greater then the number of **friendly** models in the same combat. Each **model** counts as its **Transport Capacity** for this for example a model with a **TC** of 2 counts as 2 model for this. **Mounted** and **Dreadnought** units count as 5 models unless otherwise stated and **vehicle** models count as 10.

sharedRules.name: Remorsless
sharedRules.description: As long as a model with this special rule has not **advanced**, **deep striked** or come from **reserves** this turn it counts as being **stationary** no matter how far it moved. In addition they ignore all **negative** modifiers to their **movement charecteristic**.

sharedRules.name: Medusa Scales
sharedRules.description:
Non-**Vehicle** models targeted by a **ranged attack** cause that attack to have -1 **strength** if they have this rule.
**Vehicle** units instead have the **Medusian Metal** ability

sharedRules.name: Strength of Wisdom
sharedRules.description: If a unit with this rule makes a **shooting attack** add 1 to the **hit roll** if a **friendly** unit withing 6" that has this rule has already shot the **same target**

sharedRules.name: Blood of Fire
sharedRules.description: When a **ranged attack** that comes from a **flame**, **volkite**, **plasma** or **melta** weapon target a unit with this rule it has -1 to **wound**. In addition if a model with this is **below starting wounds** at the end of your turn roll 1D6 and on 6+ restore 1 wound to that model. If it already has an ability to heal at the end of your turn based on a dice roll add 1 to the roll instead.

sharedRules.name: Shadow and Fury
sharedRules.description: Models with this rule gain a one of 3 special rules based on its **keyword** being: **Talons**, **Falcons** or **Hawks**

profiles.name: The Angels of Death:[1 Command Point]

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
During your **opponents charge phase** if a **friendly Dark Angels** units is targeted you can use this on them. Make a **leadership test** with your unit. 


Pass: This unit ignores all negative modifiers to **leadership** and have **Fear (2)**
Fail: This unit ignores modifiers to **leadership rolls** and have **Fear(1)**


These last till the end of your next turn.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
If an **enemy unit** declares a charge after it picks a **friendly Emperor's children** unit withing 8" of itself to **charge** you can use this **strategem** on the unit being **charged**.  That unit makes a **charge roll**:
- Less then the **opponents charge roll**: This unit makes a **shooting attack** into the **enemy unit**
- More then the **opponents charge roll**: This unit can **charge** that unit instead getting all the same **benefits** as if they **charged** normally.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: During your **opponents shooting phase** if a **friendly Alpha Legion** unit is **targeted** by a **ranged attack** it can move 2D6" **before** any **hit dice** are rolled then check if the unit is still a valid target. If not it still acts as if the **enemy unit** did shoot this unit but no dice are rolled and no damage is allocated.

profiles.name: The Wraith of the Angels:[2 Command Points]

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: In **your opponents shooting phase** you can use this **Strategem** on a **friendly Blood Angels Infantry** unit that has been **targeted** by a **ranged attack**. For the rest of the attack this unit has a **[Feel No Pain 5+]** against ranged attacks. After all attacks from the *8attacking** unit are done this unit can declare a **charge** but can only target the **attacker** as the **charge target**.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: In your opponents **shooting phase** if a **friendly Death Guard** unit is the target of a **ranged attack** you can give it a **[Feel No Pain 4+]** and it will not be **pinned**. After the attack is over this unit can make a **surge move** of up to 7"

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: In your **opponents charge phase** if one of your **Iron Hands** units where charged you can use this. You can use this on them and after your **opponent** completes the **charge move** and any **pile-in moves** this unit makes a **shooting attack** as if it wasn't  in **combat**. All **ranged weapons** gain twice the number of attacks but also **Hazardous** or **Overcharge** if it already has **Hazardous**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: In your **opponents shooting phase** if a **friendly Ultramarine** unit has been targeted you can use this on them. After all **hit**,**wound** and **armour saves** have been resolved but not **[Feel No Pain] rolls** and before you remove models as casulties in this unit you can make a ranged attack with this and 1 other **Ultramarine** unit however both must **target** the **attacking** unit.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: If a **friendly Salamander Infantry** unit is selected as a *target* of your opponents **charge** you can use this. Add 1 to your units **WS**,**strength** and **attacks** for all **melee weapons** in that unit for the rest of the turn. At the end of the turn roll a D6 for each model effected by this. For each 6 that model suffers 1 **Mortal Wounds**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: In your **opponents shooting phase** when a **friendly Raven Guard** is targeted by an **enemy shooting attack** you can use this on them. They can make a **move** up to half their **movement charecteristic**  then they gain a **[Feel No Pain 4+]** from all **shooting attacks** for the rest of the turn. If the **shooting attack** become impossible to **reslove** due to **terrian** or **range limits** then the **enemy unit** has considered shot.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Heavy: Units with this keyword can only advance of **D3** instead of **D6**
Artillery: Models with this can not **charge** or **advance**
Walkers: These count as **Vehicles** for the purposes of **Anti** and **Ablities** but do not for things like **detachemtns** that limit **vehciles** etc

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: All **friendly units** withing 6" of this model while in the same combat as this model gain +1 **melee strength**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model and its unit have +1" to advance and charge rolls while this model is part of the unit.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: All **Ranged weapons** in this model's unit have **Pinning** while this model is attached to it.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: All **units** with the same **Hexagrammation** withing 18" of this model gain +1 to **leadership charecteristic** (So a 6+ Ld would become a 5+) to a maximum of 5+

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Once per battle this model can make a **battleround decisive**. In the **Decisive battleround** this model and its unit gain +1BS and WS for the **round**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While this model is part of a unit that unit can ignore modifiers to **leadership roll** however when this model is **destroyed** all **friendly White Scars** units  that had **line of sight** to this model can ignore all negative modifiers to **leadership charecteristics** and **leadership rolls**  till the end of the battle.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: **FULL REWORK NEEDED**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While withing **Line of Sight** of a **friendly Sons Of Horus** this model and its unit **automatically pass battle-shock tests**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Once per battle you can activate this at the start of any **charge phase**. Till the start of your next **charge phase** when a **friendly Space Wolves** unit **charges** it gains +1 **melee strength**.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: If this model causes an **enemy model** to suffer a **unsaved wound** in the **fight phase** heal this model 1 wound. If this model is at full **wounds** instead increase the **attack** and **strength** of all melee weapons this model has by 1 till the **end** of your **next turn**.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model and its unit gain **re-roll hit** and **wound** rolls of 1 when attacking **Charecter** models and have a **[Feel No pain 5+]** when in combat with them.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model and its unit gain +1**WS** when targeting **Traitor** units

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model and its unit automatically pass **battle-shocked** tests while in your **deployment zone** or on an **objective**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While this model and its unit have **benefit of cover** or are **embarked** they can **re-roll ranged hit rolls** of 1

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While in combat with the enemy **Warlord** and/or a **Primarch**, **Dreadnought** or **Titanic** if an attack's **damage charecteristic** was greater then this models **current wounds** set the **damage charecteristic** to D3. Furthermore if there is atleast 1 **enemy unit** withing 12" this model and its unit **must** make a **charge**.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: At the start of battle before any models are **deployed** select 1 **Faction Keyword**. This model ignores negative modifiers to its **leadership charecteristic and **leadership rolls** while in combat with an **enemy unit** with that **keyword**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When a **friendly unit** withing 12" becomes **battle-shocked** it instead suffers 1 **mortal wound** and is considered to not have been **battle-shocked**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: All **friendly** units locked in the same combat as this model have +1 **to hit** against **Traitor** models

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When a **friendly unit** withing 12" passes a **battle-shock** test you can use this **warlord trait**. It gains +1**WS** for the turn. You can only uses this on the **same unit** once per game.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Any **Allied units** do not count towards your opponents **Primary** and **Secondary missions**.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three **Alpha Legion** units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can not set those units up in Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When the game starts before any unit is deployed chose 1 **Faction keyword**. This model and its unit have +1 to hit models with that **keyword**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This **model** counts as having **Fear (1)** for all **Traitor** units. When this model and/or its unit **destroyes** a **Traitror** unit increase this value by 1 at the end of that phase.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: **Friendly Blood Angel** units that can draw **line of sight** to this model have +1 to their **leadership rolls**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: If their is at least 1 **enemy unit** withing 12" in **your charge phase** this model and its unit must **declare a charge**. After this unit **charges** improve the number of melee attacks by 2 for the **rest of the turn**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: All **enemy units** withing 12" suffer -2 to **leadership rolls**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model gains +1 **toughness** against **[Psychic]** weapons and all **friendly Death Guard** units withing 12" gain **Admantine Will (6+)**.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model can only suffer **critical hits** and **wounds** on a **natural 6** no matter what abilities the **model**,**unit** and/or **weapon** has

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model gains **Fear(1)** and when this model is **destroyed** for the 1st time this game roll 1D6. On a 2+ this model can preform a **shooting** or **fight** attack based on what **phase** this model was **destroyed** in. **Shooting** = **Shoot**, **Fight** = **fight**.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model and its unit get **re-roll hit** and **wound rolls** of 1 against **loyalist**.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model and its unit can not have their **charecteristic negatively modified** in any way.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: As soon as this model full below **starting wounds** it gains **[Feel No Pain 4+]** and can ignore **Fear(X)**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: If a **friendly Ultramarine** unit has **line of sight** of this model it can use this models **leadership charecteristic** for any **battle-shock test**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Once per battle at the start of your command phase you can use this. Add this models **leadership Charecteritic** to its Toughness till the start of your next turn.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model and its unit gain +1 **melee strength** when locked into combat with a **enemy** unit that has some form of **Fear(X)** and can **re-roll** all **melee hit rolls** in the turn it charges a **Traitor** unit. You can not bring any units in this army with **Bitter Duty**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model and its unit gain +1 to **wound** with **flame** or **volkite** weapons.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: All models in this models **force** reduce the effect of the **Fear(X)** by 1 (So **Fear(1)** would become **Fear(0)**).You can not bring any units in this army with **Bitter Duty**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Benefits
-You can take up to 3 **Rewards of Treachery** units and all of them are immune to negative modifiers to their **leadership charecteristic** and **rolls** 
- All units gain +1 to hit the turn they are deployed.
- You have no pts limit on **reserves** [Though still a pts limit for **deep strike**]



Limitations
-  All non-**Rewards of Treachery** units must start the game in reserves in this force
- All **Rewards of Treachery** units must be deployed in the **deployment phase**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Benefits
- **Headhunter Kill teams** become **battleline** and have +1OC
- You get +2VP when a **Alpha Legion** unit destroys the **opponents warlord**
- All **Infantry** units gain **[Feel No Pain 5+]** against ranged attacks while further then 12" from **enemy units** in the first **battle-round**


Limitations
- All **vehicles** must begin the game in reserves
- You must have more **Fast Attacker** then **Heavy Surpport** units

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Benefits
- You can have up to 50% of your army in **Deep Strike**
- All units that **started** the game on the board and have not be **re-deployed** since ignore **Fear**


Limitations
- All **Charecter leader** units must take a **Warhawk Jump Pack** and start in **deep strike**
- You can not bring any **fortifications** unless they have **Deep strike**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Benefits
- **Crimson Paladin** units gain **Battleline**
- All **Infantry** units on an **objective** ignore modifiers to **leadership rolls**
- When a **Infantry Blood Angels** unit is below **half-starting strength** they gain **Heart of the Legion** can **re-roll melee hit rolls** the turn they charge and gain +1OC.


Limitations
- When a **Infantry Blood Angels** unit is below **half-starting strength** if there is at least 1 **enemy unit** withing 12" in **your charge phase** then this unit must declare a **charge**
- No unit can be placed into **Deep Strike** or **Reserves**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Benefits
- **Legion Veteran Squads** gain **battleline**
- **Legion Heavy Squads** loose **Heavy Support** and gain **Battleline**
- All **Charecter** and **Sergeant** models can take **rad grenades** for 10pts


Limitations
- No model can make an **advance move**
- You can not put any units into **reserves**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Benefits
- All **friendly Death Guard** models in your **deployment zone** gain a **[Feel No Pain 6+]** against **shooting attacks**
- **Grave Warden Terminators** gain **battleline**


Limitations
- You must include 1 **Siege Breaker** model in your army

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Benefits
- Up to 4 units at the start of the game that do not have the **Heavy** or **Artillery** keyword can be placed into reserves without effecting the total pts in **reserves**
- Until you bring 1 unit from **reserves** or **deep strike** all **deployed Emperor's Children** units gain +1" to their **movement charecteristic**
- When using the **Rapid Ingress** you can bring up to 3 units


Limitations
- You can not bring any **Artillery** units
- At least 25% of the pts in your army must be placed in reserves
- You must take a **Champion** or **Phoenix Warden charecter**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Benefits
- **Karkophoni Squads** gains **battleline**
- Any **infantry** model can take a **surgical augmentation**


Limitations
- All **Charecter** and **Sergeants** must take a **surgical Augmentation**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Benefits
- **Phalanx Warden Squads** gain **battleline**, +1**OC** and **Heart of the Legion**
- All models with a **Boarding shield** can **re-roll** failed **Invulnerable saves** if they have 2 other models in their unit still alive and with **Boarding shields** in a turn which they have not **advanced** or **charged** 
- All models with a **Boarding shield** gain **Hammer of Wrath (1)** if they have 2 other models in their unit still alive and with **Boarding shields**


Limitations
- You must take 2 **Phalanx Warden Squads**
- You can not put any units in **Deep Strike** or **Reserves**
- You must take more **Battleline** then all non-**Vehicle** and non-**Battleline** units.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Benefits
- **Phalan Warden Squads** gain **battleline**
- All **Infantry** units can take **Teleport Strike**
- When a unit that has **Teleport Strike** **deep strikes** they gain a **[Feel No Pain 5+]** against ranged attacks till the **start of the next turn**


Limitations
- **Vehicles** must be placed in **reserves** and can not **deep strike**
- You can not bring **fortifications

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Benefits
- You can bring **Black Templar units**
- **Templar Brethren** gain +1**OC**, **Battleline** and **Heart of the Legion**
- When a **Black Templar unit disembarks** it gains +2 melee attacks for the turn if it **charges** in the same turn.


Limitations
- You must bring 2 **Templar Brethren** 
- You can not bring non**Space Marine** allies
- You can not bring more non-**battleline** units then **battleline**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Benefits
- **Legion Sky-hunter Squadrons** and **Legion Outrider Squadrons** gain +1**OC** and **battleline**


Limitations
- All non-**Transport Vehicles**, **Titanic** and **Infantry** that are not **embarked** must be **placed in reserves**
- You can not bring **Heavy Support** or **fortification** unless they have the **fly keyword**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Benefits
- **Ebon Keshig Cohort** gain **Battleline**
- All non-**epic hero infantry** units gain **Kharash** and **[Feel No Pain 5+]**
- When a **friendly white scares Kharash** unit **charges** they ignore **Fear(X)** till the **start of your next turn**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Benefits
- All **Space Wolves** gain **re-roll hit rolls** in a turn it **charges** if they target a **traitor** unit 
- All **Space Wolves** gain **re-roll hit** and **wound rolls** of 1 when targeting a **Primarch**
- While in the same **fight** as a **Traitor Primarch Space Wolves** ignore **Fear(X)**
- The **distance between** a **friendly Space Wolves** unit and a **Primarch** is reduced by 2" for the purposes of **charge distance**


Limitations
- You can not take any **Vehicle** or **Primarch** models
-

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Benefits
- **Grey Slayer Pack** and **Grey Stalker Pack** gain **Hit and Run**
- When a **Infantry** or **Mounted** units comes from **reserves** (but not **deep strike**) it gains +2" to **advance** and **charge rolls** and +2 **melee attacks** in the turn it **charges** for the rest of the tune. This lasts until the **start** of the your or your oppnents turn whatever persons turn they came in on
- You can use **Rapid Ingress** **twice** per **battleround**


Limitations
- You can not take **Heavy Support**
- You must have atleast 25% of your army in **reserves**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Benefits
Once per battle you can declare a **Bloody Charge** and all **Space Wolve** units gain the following till the **start** of **your next turn**:
- +1 to **Leadership Charecteritic**
- +2" to **advance** and **charge rolls** and +1 **melee strength** when the unit **charged** this turn
- Ignore modifiers to **leadership rolls** or just ignore negative modifiers to **leadership** if it already **ignores** them for **rolls**


Limitations
- When you declare a **Bloody Charge** if there is at least 1 **enemy unit** is withing 12" of a **friendly Space Wolves** unit then that unit must **declare a charge**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Benefits
- **Medusan Immortal Squads** gain **battleline**, +1**OC** and **Heart of the Legion**
- All **Bitter Duty Iron Hands** units gain **re-roll hit rolls** on the turn they **charge**
- All **Leader** models can be given **Bitter Duty**


Limitations
- You can not bring **Ferrus Manus**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Benefits
- While in **your deployment zone** **friendly Iron Hands infantry** units ignore modifiers to **leadership rolls**
- **Flamers** can be replaced by **graviton guns** and **graviton shredders**
- You can take **Castellax Battle-automata** and they gain **Medusian Forged** ability
- **Iron-Farthers** and **Legion Techmarines** can take **cortex controller** for 15pts


Limitation
- You can only take 1 **Fast Attacker** per 1k
- You must go **Second**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Benefits:
- At the start of each of your **command phases** you can select 1 **Logos Lectora Command**. You can not select the same one you did in your last turn. The effect applies to all **friendly Infantry Ultramarine** units until the start of your next turn.


Limitations
- You must bring 1 **Master of Signals** or **Legion Damocles Command Rhino**
- You must bring 3 **Battleline** units
- You can not place any Units in **reserves**, **deep strike** or **deploy** using **infiltrators** rule [They can still be set up in your **deployment zone** as if they didnt have the rule]

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Benefits
- **Pyroclast Squads** and **Legion Tactical Squads** gain **battleline** if they have **any model** with a **Dragon's Breath Flamer** and gain +1**OC**
- **Legion Predator Squads** also gain **Battleline** if they have **Dragon's Breathe Cannon** and **Dragon's Breath Heavy Flamer** as weapons


Limitations
- You can not use **Deep Strike**
- You can not bring any unit with the **Bitter Duty** keyword
- You must bring atleast 1 **Champion** model

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Benefits
- All **Infantry Salamander** units can take **Fear(1)** for 20pts
- Any **Psyker** model can take the **Fury of the Salamander Psychic Discipline** instead


Limitations
- You can only include 1 **mounted** unit per 1k points
- You can not take any unit that has a **Warhawk Jump Pack**
- You must bring 1 **Chaplin** model
- You may not bring **Vulkan**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Benefits
- **Legion Predator Squadrons** gain **TROOPS**
- **Legion Kratos Squadrons** gain **ELITES**


Limitations
- All **Infantry** units must be **embarked** in a **transport** at the start of **battle** and can not be in a **Fly transport**
- All **TROOPS Legion Predator Squadrons** and **ELITES Legion Kratos Squadrons** must be **Ironwing**
- You can not place an units into **Reserves**
- Your warlord must be **Ironwing** or **Lion El'Jonson**/**Lion El'Jonson: Lord of the First**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Benefits
- **Legion Tactical Squads**, **Legion Assault Squads** and **Legion Despoiler Squads** can take a **Legion Centurion** but it must be a **Stormwing** and cant be your **warlord**
- All **Leader Stormwing** models can **ignore** modifys to their **leadership rolls**
- **Legion Tactical Squads**, **Legion Assault Squads** and **Legion Despoiler Squads** gain **ELETIES**
- **Legion Assault Squads** gain **Fast Attacker**


Limitations
- All **Legion Tactical Squads**, **Legion Assault Squads** and **Legion Despoiler Squads** must be **Stormwing**
- You must take the maximum model size in **Battleline** units
- Your **battleline** units must be deployed in the deployment phase on the board
- Your **warlord** must be **stormwing** or **Lion El'Jonson**/**Lion El'Jonson: Lord of the First**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Benefits
- **Legion Veteran Squads**, **Legion Tartaros Squads** and **Legion Cataphractii Squads** gain **TROOPS** and **Heart of the legion**
- **Deathwing Leader** models have +1 attacks while on an objective


Limitations
- If you do not controll the **Center Objective** at the end of the game you **opponent** scores 1 **victory point** or D3 if they controll it
- **Legion Veteran Squads**, **Legion Tartaros Squads** and **Legion Cataphractii Squads** must be **Deathwing**
- Your warlord must be **Deathwing** or **Lion El'Jonson**/**Lion El'Jonson: Lord of the First**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Benefits
- **Legion Sky-hunter Squadrons** and **Legion Outrider Squadrons** gain **TROOP**
- **Leader Mounted** models gain +2 **melee attacks** in a turn it **charges** and is **Outnumbered**


Limitation
- You can not take **vehicle** units that do not also have the **Fast Attacker**, **Mounted** or **Fly**
- You can only take 1 **Heavy Support** units per 1k in this force
- All **TROOPS** and **FAST ATTACKER** must be **Ravenwing**
- Your **warlord** must be **Ravenwing** or **Lion El'Jonson**/**Lion El'Jonson: Lord of the First**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Benefits
- **Legion Seeker Squadrons** gain **TROOP**
- At the end of the **deployment phase** select 3 of your **opponents Primarchs**, **leaders** or **titanics**. These become **Priority Assets**. If there is not enough you can select any unit after selecting as many as you could from the list.
- All **Firewing**  gain +1 **to hit** and +1 **Melee attacks** when attacking a unit that contains atleast 1 **Priority Asset**
- Up to 3 **Battleline** units can be given **Infiltrators**


Limitations
- All **TROOPS** units must be **Firewing**
- For each **Priority Asset** still alive, not **battle-shocked** or **pinned** and on the board at the end of the game your opponent gains 3 **victory points** 
- Your **Warlord** must be **Firewing** or **Lion El'Jonson**/**Lion El'Jonson: Lord of the First**

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Benefits
- All **Legion Destroyer Assault Squads**, **Legion Mortalis Destroyer Squads** and **Dreadwing Interemptor Squads** gain **TROOP**
- All **Dreadwing** units get +1 to wound against targets in a **terrian area**


Limitations
- Your **Warlord** must be **Dreadwing** or **Lion El'Jhonson**/**Lion El'Jonson: Lord of the First**
- If there are **enemy units** in the **opponents deployment zone** that are not **battle-shocked** or **pinned** then your opponent gets D3VP
- You can not bring **fortifications**
